subject: Discoloured Dermacalm cream caused a burning rash
body_text:
Hello,

I bought a tube of Dermacalm cream last month, batch number DC-4471-B. When I opened it the cream was brown rather than white and smelled strongly of chemicals. The seal under the cap was already broken.

I used it anyway on my forearm and within an hour I had a burning sensation and the skin blistered. I am 33 years old. I saw my pharmacist who told me to stop using it and report it. The blisters are healing now.

I have photographs of the tube and my arm if those are useful.

Priya Raman, Leeds, UK
